comparison.objective: Assemble shock-corded mast segments into a straight pole and place it on stands.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated segment alignment, insertion, cord management, regrasping, and long-object placement.
comparison.success_condition: Every joint is fully seated, pole is straight, and it rests across two stands after release; numeric joint tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Despite the word “shock,” this is mast assembly with an elastic cord, not shock-absorber commissioning.
